description: This Java source file defines the 'ColumnValidator' class, which provides methods for validating SQL column references and preventing SQL injection by analyzing and checking SQL conditions and table/column references within the context of a database schema.

classes.name: ColumnValidator
classes.description: A utility class responsible for validating SQL columns and preventing SQL injection attacks by analyzing SQL conditions, table aliases, and columns within a given schema context.

methods.name: validateColumn
methods.description: Validates if the specified columns exist in the database tables, throwing validation exceptions if invalid columns are found.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Extracts and returns the set of column names from a JDBC ResultSet representing table metadata.

methods.name: validateSqlInjection
methods.description: Main method to validate SQL conditions for potential injection threats, parsing conditions, extracting operands, generating table-column mappings, and validating columns.

methods.name: getTableColumnMap
methods.description: Maps table aliases to their corresponding columns based on the schema SQL string and alias mapping.

methods.name: getTableColumnAliasMap
methods.description: Parses operands (parts of the SQL condition) to map table aliases to their columns.

methods.name: getOperand
methods.description: Analyzes a SQL condition string to extract operand tokens.

methods.name: getOperand
methods.description: Helper method to extract a specific operand around a given operator position in a condition string.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces specified SQL operators in a condition string with a spaced version for parsing, handling specific operator cases such as '=', '< =', '>='.
